description: Robert accepts both fictional-scenario rules with their scenario numbers unchanged: policy version 1 is created. The rules keep origin FICTIONAL_SCENARIO because the numbers were accepted as offered.

objectives.original_words: Preserve my capital while keeping some growth potential over the next 3 to 5 years.

rule.original_words: Fictional scenario: no more than 10% of the portfolio in any single company, funds included.
rule.scope_description: Maximum total equity exposure to any single company: direct holdings plus look-through via equity funds, share classes of one company added together. Bond funds, commodity funds and crypto assets are outside this rule's scope and are not assessed.

rule.original_words: Fictional scenario: replayed through 2022, the portfolio should not end the year more than 10% lower.
rule.scope_description: Maximum terminal loss of the evaluated allocation replayed from 2021-12-31 to 2022-12-30 (buy and hold, cash earning 0, in CAD). This replays an assumed allocation through history: it is not a forecast and not a maximum future loss. Drawdown inside the period is reported separately and is not part of this rule.
